FlowDefinition.description: Autolaunched flow that assembles the grounded Work Order context used by the Technician Copilot and Technician AI Chat experiences. It combines Work Order, Case, Asset, warranty, service-history, and required-parts information into a structured technician briefing. This helper flow is not launched directly by end users.
